Steps

Initial QAQC of raw data
Using Docker for QAQC Using Docker is kind of having an apartment in an apartment building. The Docker image/template is built and users are able to use a container to work in. So the image is like the building and the container is like an apartment in the building. Users share the kernel (likened to plumbing in the example), but they have their own way to get in. The important thing to remember is that any changes made in a container are temporary.
